brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of the free area and clear any obstruction before the forecast heat event, as instructed in SOP-015. Check that louvre blades are not bent, corroded, or missing, and verify that insect mesh is intact and unblinded. Because this ageing unit cannot be attended to before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure.
